title: Lead-Time Count for Returned Reduction Addenda — Group Room Blocks
content:
On Group Room Blocks, the day from which the days before arrival of a reduction are counted follows the addendum's return, that is, how long before its implementation the reduction addendum was issued. The days are whole calendar days to the block's arrival date.

| Reduction addendum issued, before the date it is implemented | Days before arrival counted from |
|---|---|
| no more than 30 calendar days | the addendum's issue date |
| more than 30 but no more than 60 calendar days | the day 30 calendar days after the issue date |
| more than 60 calendar days | the date the addendum is implemented |

The issue date is the date the addendum was issued to the organiser, as shown on the addendum record.

### Worked counts (hypothetical calendar: addendum issued on day 0, arrival on day 250)

| Implemented on | Days since issue | Counted from | Days before arrival |
|---|---|---|---|
| day 20 | 20 | day 0 (issue date) | 250 |
| day 30 | 30 | day 0 (issue date) | 250 |
| day 31 | 31 | day 30 | 220 |
| day 45 | 45 | day 30 | 220 |
| day 60 | 60 | day 30 | 220 |
| day 61 | 61 | day 61 (implementation date) | 189 |

Thirty days is the last day counted from the issue date and sixty days the last day counted from the thirtieth day after issue.
